courseDetails.title: Regulamento da Inteligência Artificial da UE: guia 2026
courseDetails.shortDescription: Atualizado com o Omnibus Digital (Regulamento (UE) 2026/1744): classifique, documente, comprove e planeje a conformidade
courseDetails.longDescription:
Este curso contém o uso de inteligência artificial.

O Regulamento da Inteligência Artificial da União Europeia (AI Act), o Regulamento (UE) 2024/1689, é a regulação de IA de maior impacto no mundo, e 2026 é o ano em que ele deixa de ser teoria para a sua organização. As práticas proibidas já podem ser punidas. As obrigações dos modelos de IA de finalidade geral se aplicam desde agosto de 2025. O Omnibus Digital — Regulamento (UE) 2026/1744, em vigor desde 27 de julho de 2026 — adiou as obrigações dos sistemas de risco elevado do anexo III para 2 de dezembro de 2027 (sistemas do anexo I: 2 de agosto de 2028). Parece um prazo longo, até você perceber que as avaliações da conformidade, a documentação técnica do anexo IV, as avaliações de impacto sobre os direitos fundamentais e os pacotes de evidências entre prestador e responsável pela implantação precisam estar prontos bem antes do prazo.

Este curso é uma caixa de ferramentas para quem aplica o regulamento. Não é um tratado jurídico nem uma preparação para exame: é o caderno de trabalho de que você precisa para colocar o regulamento em prática já na segunda-feira de manhã. Percorremos cada capítulo do regulamento com a profundidade que a prática exige, das definições do artigo 3 às sanções do artigo 99, incluindo as alterações do Omnibus Digital. Você vai aprender a classificar qualquer sistema de IA à luz do artigo 6 e do anexo III, a montar a documentação técnica do anexo IV, a delimitar e conduzir uma avaliação de impacto sobre os direitos fundamentais e a planejar um roteiro de 18 meses que o seu conselho de administração possa aprovar.

Ancorado numa empresa europeia realista. Cada conceito, cada exemplo e cada exercício acontece na Lumora HR, uma empresa de tecnologia de recrutamento com sede em Berlim que é ao mesmo tempo prestador de um sistema de pré-seleção de risco elevado, responsável pela implantação de ferramentas internas de IA e prestador a jusante que trabalha sobre um modelo de IA de finalidade geral. Ao final da parte 7, você terá acompanhado a Lumora desde uma crise — o pedido de evidências de um cliente — até um roteiro de conformidade pronto para o conselho. Esse fio condutor único é o que faz o conteúdo ficar na memória.

O que você vai saber fazer ao final do curso:

  • Classificar qualquer sistema de IA à luz do artigo 6, do anexo I e do anexo III, e aplicar o teste de derrogação do artigo 6(3)
  • Montar a documentação técnica do anexo IV, as instruções de utilização do artigo 13 e o pacote de evidências do responsável pela implantação do artigo 26
  • Delimitar e conduzir uma avaliação de impacto sobre os direitos fundamentais (AIDF) nos termos do artigo 27, e conciliá-la com uma AIPD do GDPR
  • Montar um roteiro de conformidade de 18 meses alinhado ao calendário do Omnibus Digital
  • Entender o Código de Práticas para a IA de Finalidade Geral e obter as evidências certas dos fornecedores dos seus modelos
  • Apresentar ao conselho de administração a exposição a sanções nos três níveis do artigo 99

Para quem é:

  • Profissionais de conformidade e líderes de governança de IA que estão estruturando um programa de adequação
  • Encarregados de proteção de dados (DPO) que estão ampliando sua atuação para os riscos de IA
  • Auditores internos responsáveis pelos controles de IA
  • Gestores de riscos que estão construindo uma taxonomia de riscos de IA
  • Consultores de GRC que assessoram clientes europeus

Pré-requisitos:

  • Conhecimento prático do GDPR, o regulamento geral de proteção de dados da União Europeia (supomos que você sabe o que é uma AIPD e o que faz o artigo 6 do GDPR)
  • Noções de sistemas de gestão (experiência com ISO 27001 ou ISO 9001 ajuda, mas não é necessária)
  • Curiosidade sobre IA, mas nenhuma formação técnica em aprendizado de máquina é necessária

O que o curso inclui:

  • 33 videoaulas em 7 partes: mais de quatro horas de vídeo, com foco na prática
  • 7 questionários, com 50 perguntas no total, um ao final de cada parte
  • 5 exercícios com soluções completas (memorando de classificação, sumário da documentação do anexo IV, delimitação de uma AIDF, procedimento para incidentes graves, matriz de evidências dos fornecedores GPAI)
  • Um projeto final: o roteiro de conformidade de 18 meses apresentado ao conselho de administração
  • 23 modelos Word para baixar, citados ao longo do curso, entre eles: inventário de sistemas de IA, árvore de decisão de classificação, estrutura do anexo IV, formulário de AIDF, biblioteca de avisos de transparência (artigo 50), questionário ao fornecedor, declaração UE de conformidade, procedimento de comunicação de incidentes graves e correspondência com a ISO 42001. Modelos, aulas, questionários e exercícios estão em português.

Situação jurídica de outubro de 2026, incluindo o Omnibus Digital (Regulamento (UE) 2026/1744); o estudo de caso da Lumora se passa em maio de 2026. O regulamento e as orientações do Serviço para a IA continuam evoluindo. Em cada aula, sinalizamos o que reflete a situação numa data específica, para que você saiba o que verificar de novo antes de entregar seus documentos a um organismo notificado ou a um auditor. Este curso é uma formação, e não uma assessoria jurídica.

Ao final deste curso, você não será mais a pessoa que diz na reunião “acho que precisamos dar uma olhada no regulamento de IA”. Você será quem coloca na mesa o inventário, a classificação, a documentação técnica, a AIDF e o roteiro.
targetAudiences: Profissionais de conformidade e líderes de governança de IA de organizações que atuam na UE e se preparam para os prazos de dezembro de 2027 e agosto de 2028
Encarregados de proteção de dados (DPO) que estão ampliando sua prática do GDPR para os riscos de IA

courseDetails.title: Quantum Physics to Quantum Computing Masterclass
courseDetails.shortDescription: A beginner-friendly, step-by-step path from the basics of quantum physics to advanced quantum computing
courseDetails.longDescription:
This course contains the use of artificial intelligence.

Step into the fascinating world of quantum physics and learn how its revolutionary principles power the next generation of quantum computers. Quantum Physics to Quantum Computing Mastery is a beginner-friendly, step-by-step course designed to take you from the fundamentals of quantum mechanics to advanced quantum computing concepts, algorithms, hardware, and practical projects.

You do not need a background in physics or advanced mathematics to begin. The course introduces essential topics using clear explanations, visual intuition, practical examples, and hands-on programming exercises. You will first explore the foundations of quantum physics, including wave-particle duality, superposition, measurement, the uncertainty principle, quantum states, and entanglement.

Next, you will build the mathematical foundation required for quantum computing. You will learn algebra, vectors, matrices, complex numbers, probability, statistics, and linear algebra in an approachable way. These concepts will help you understand how qubits, quantum gates, state vectors, and quantum circuits work.

The course then introduces the fundamentals of quantum information science, including bits versus qubits, the Bloch sphere, single-qubit operations, multi-qubit systems, quantum gates, and circuit design. You will discover how quantum computers differ from classical computers and explore important applications in cryptography, optimization, scientific simulation, artificial intelligence, and machine learning.

Using Python for quantum computing and Qiskit, you will create quantum circuits, run simulations, interpret measurement results, and debug quantum programs. You will also study popular quantum algorithms, including the Deutsch algorithm, Deutsch-Jozsa algorithm, Grover’s search algorithm, and Shor’s algorithm. The course explains quantum speedup and helps you understand when quantum algorithms can provide meaningful advantages.

As you progress, you will explore intermediate and advanced topics such as tensor products, Bell states, quantum teleportation, quantum cryptography, variational quantum algorithms, the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm, quantum machine learning, noise models, and quantum error mitigation.

You will also gain a practical understanding of quantum error correction, decoherence, logical qubits, physical qubits, fault-tolerant quantum computing, and the challenges involved in scaling quantum systems.

The hardware section examines leading quantum technologies, including superconducting qubits, ion traps, photonic quantum computing, and neutral-atom systems. You will compare their strengths, limitations, and potential roles in the future of quantum technology.

Hands-on quantum computing projects include building a quantum random number generator, creating Bell states, implementing Grover’s algorithm, simulating quantum circuits, and exploring quantum encryption. You will complete a capstone project that demonstrates your growing quantum computing skills.

By the end of the course, you will have a strong foundation in quantum mechanics, quantum programming, Qiskit, quantum algorithms, quantum hardware, and quantum information science. You will also learn about quantum computing careers, research pathways, portfolio development, interview preparation, and opportunities for continued learning.

Whether you are a student, developer, engineer, researcher, technology professional, or curious beginner, this course provides a structured path toward mastering one of the most exciting and transformative technologies of the future.

courseDetails.title: AB Yapay Zekâ Yasası (AI Act) 2026: Uygulamalı Kurs
courseDetails.shortDescription: Dijital Omnibus ((AB) 2026/1744 sayılı Tüzük) ile güncel: sınıflandırma, belgeler, kanıtlar ve uyum yol haritası
courseDetails.longDescription:
This course contains the use of artificial intelligence.

Bu kurs, yapay zekâ kullanımını içermektedir.

AB Yapay Zekâ Yasası (AI Act), yani (AB) 2024/1689 sayılı Tüzük, dünyanın en kapsamlı sonuçlar doğuran yapay zekâ düzenlemesidir ve 2026, kuruluşunuz için teorinin geride kaldığı yıldır. Yasaklanan uygulamalar zaten uygulatılıyor. Genel amaçlı yapay zekâ modellerine ilişkin yükümlülükler Ağustos 2025'ten beri yürürlükte. Dijital Omnibus, yani 27 Temmuz 2026'dan beri yürürlükte olan (AB) 2026/1744 sayılı Tüzük, Ek III kapsamındaki yüksek riskli sistemlere ilişkin yükümlülükleri 2 Aralık 2027 tarihine erteledi (Ek I sistemleri: 2 Ağustos 2028). Bu uzun bir hazırlık süresi gibi görünür; ta ki uygunluk değerlendirmelerinin, Ek IV teknik dosyalarının, temel haklar etki değerlendirmelerinin ve sağlayıcı ile uygulayıcı arasındaki kanıt dosyalarının son tarihten çok önce hazırlanması gerektiğini fark edene kadar.

Bu kurs, uygulayıcılar için bir araç setidir. Akademik bir hukuk çalışması ya da sınav hazırlığı değil; pazartesi sabahı Yapay Zekâ Yasası uyumu üzerinde çalışmaya başlamanız için gereken çalışma kitabıdır. Tüzük'ün her bölümünü, Md. 3'teki tanımlardan Md. 99'daki yaptırımlara ve Dijital Omnibus değişikliklerine kadar uygulamada gereken derinlikte ele alıyoruz. Her yapay zekâ sistemini Md. 6 ve Ek III'e göre sınıflandırmayı, Ek IV teknik dosyasını hazırlamayı, temel haklar etki değerlendirmesinin kapsamını belirleyip yürütmeyi ve yönetim kurulunuzun onaylayacağı 18 aylık bir yol haritası planlamayı öğreneceksiniz.

Gerçekçi tek bir Avrupa şirketi üzerine kurulu. Her kavram, her örnek ve her ödev, merkezi Berlin'de bulunan bir işe alım teknolojisi şirketi olan Lumora HR'da geçer. Lumora aynı anda yüksek riskli bir ön eleme sisteminin sağlayıcısı, şirket içi yapay zekâ araçlarının uygulayıcısı ve genel amaçlı bir yapay zekâ modeli üzerine ürün geliştiren bir alt kademe sağlayıcıdır. 7. ünitenin sonunda Lumora'yı bir müşterinin kanıt talebiyle başlayan krizden yönetim kuruluna sunulmaya hazır bir uyum yol haritasına taşımış olacaksınız. Konuların akılda kalmasını sağlayan da bu tek anlatı omurgasıdır.

Kurs sonunda neler yapabileceksiniz:

  • Her yapay zekâ sistemini Md. 6, Ek I, Ek III ve Md. 6(3) istisna testine göre sınıflandırmak
  • Ek IV teknik dosyasını, Md. 13 kullanım talimatlarını ve Md. 26 uygulayıcı kanıt dosyasını hazırlamak
  • Md. 27 kapsamında temel haklar etki değerlendirmesinin (FRIA) kapsamını belirleyip yürütmek ve onu GDPR kapsamındaki DPIA ile uyumlu hâle getirmek
  • Omnibus sonrası takvime bağlı 18 aylık bir uyum yol haritası çıkarmak
  • Genel Amaçlı Yapay Zekâ Uygulama Kuralları'nı çözümlemek ve model tedarikçilerinizden doğru kanıtları almak
  • Yönetim kurulunuza Md. 99'un üç kademesindeki yaptırım riskini anlatmak

Kimler için:

  • Yapay Zekâ Yasası programlarının kapsamını belirleyen uyum uzmanları ve yapay zekâ yönetişimi sorumluları
  • Çalışma alanını yapay zekâ risklerine genişleten veri koruma görevlileri
  • Yapay zekâ kontrollerini denetleyen iç denetçiler
  • Yapay zekâ risk sınıflandırmaları oluşturan risk yöneticileri
  • Avrupalı müşterilere danışmanlık veren yönetişim, risk ve uyum (GRC) danışmanları

Gereksinimler:

  • GDPR hakkında uygulamaya dönük bilgi (DPIA'nın ne olduğunu ve GDPR Md. 6'nın neyi düzenlediğini bildiğinizi varsayıyoruz)
  • Yönetim sistemlerine temel düzeyde aşinalık (ISO 27001 veya ISO 9001 deneyimi yardımcı olur ama şart değildir)
  • Yapay zekâya merak — teknik makine öğrenmesi bilgisi gerekmez

Kursta neler var:

  • 7 ünitede 33 video ders — dört saatten uzun, odaklı ve uygulamaya dönük içerik
  • Açıklamalı ve ilgili derslere atıf yapan 7 test (toplam 50 soru)

  • Bir bitirme projesi — kendi kuruluşunuz için yönetim kuruluna sunulmaya hazır 18 aylık uyum yol haritası sunumu
  • Kurs boyunca kullanılan, indirilebilir 23 Türkçe Word şablonu: yapay zekâ sistemleri envanteri, sınıflandırma karar ağacı, Ek IV teknik dosya taslağı, FRIA formu, Md. 50 bilgilendirme metinleri kütüphanesi, tedarikçi anketi, AB uygunluk beyanı, ciddi olay bildirim el kitabı, ISO 42001 eşleştirmesi ve daha fazlası

Ekim 2026 itibarıyla hukuki durum, Dijital Omnibus ((AB) 2026/1744 sayılı Tüzük) dâhil; Lumora vaka çalışması Mayıs 2026'da geçer. Tüzük ve Yapay Zekâ Ofisi'nin kılavuz ilkeleri değişmeye devam ediyor. Belirli bir tarihe göre geçerli olan her bilgiyi ilgili derste işaretliyoruz; böylece belgelerinizi bir onaylanmış kuruluşa veya denetçiye iletmeden önce neyi yeniden doğrulamanız gerektiğini bilirsiniz. Bu kursun sonunda, toplantıda “Sanırım Yapay Zekâ Yasası'na bir bakmamız gerekiyor.” diyen kişi siz olmayacaksınız. Envanteri, sınıflandırmayı, teknik dosyayı, FRIA'yı ve yol haritasını masaya koyan kişi siz olacaksınız.

  • Kesiagaan darurat dipisahkan dari operasi abnormal
  • Audit internal kini wajib menetapkan sasaran, bukan hanya ruang lingkup dan kriteria
  • Tinjauan manajemen memiliki struktur baru: masukan, proses, dan hasil

Semua contoh berpijak pada TerraForge Industries, produsen komponen logam presisi dari Austria dengan lini pelapisan listrik, limbah berbahaya, dan interaksi nyata dengan kawasan alam yang sensitif. Managing Social Anxiety in the Workplace

The workplace is a dynamic environment that demands constant interaction, collaboration, and adaptability. For individuals grappling with social anxiety, these demands can be daunting, often leading to stress, reduced productivity, and missed opportunities for growth.

Social anxiety in the workplace is more than just shyness; it involves intense fear or apprehension about social situations, making everyday tasks feel overwhelming.


Why Addressing Social Anxiety Matters

Social anxiety can significantly hinder professional development. Employees may avoid public speaking, networking, or even casual team discussions due to fear of judgment or criticism. This avoidance not only impacts individual performance but can also reduce team cohesion and organizational success.


Understanding and managing workplace anxiety is essential for fostering inclusive and productive environments.


Common Triggers

Key situations that exacerbate social anxiety in the workplace include:

  • Presentations and Meetings: Speaking in front of peers can induce panic.

  • Networking Events: Fear of initiating or maintaining conversations.

  • Feedback Sessions: Worry about criticism from managers.

Example Impact

Consider a marketing professional who avoids presenting ideas during meetings due to social anxiety. By implementing techniques from this course, they can gradually build confidence, ensuring their valuable contributions aren’t overlooked.

This course isn’t just about overcoming challenges; it’s about empowering professionals to transform their anxiety into an opportunity for personal and professional growth.


Most importantly, it is a course to help Organisations provide actionable tools for their colleagues and participants in making the organisation function properly. It is a vital tool which can transform the individuals working within the organisation, and the organisation by extension.

This course provides practical tools to recognize and manage social anxiety in professional settings:


- Understanding Social Anxiety: Definitions, causes, and symptoms in workplace contexts.

- Identifying Triggers: Recognizing personal and environmental factors that cause anxiety.

- Impact of Social Anxiety on Careers: How it affects communication, collaboration, and leadership.

courseDetails.title: Regolamento UE sull'IA (AI Act) 2026: corso pratico
courseDetails.shortDescription: Aggiornato all'Omnibus digitale (Regolamento (UE) 2026/1744): classificare, documentare, dimostrare e pianificare
courseDetails.longDescription:
In questo corso vengono utilizzati strumenti di intelligenza artificiale.

Il regolamento europeo sull'intelligenza artificiale (AI Act), il Regolamento (UE) 2024/1689, è la normativa sull'IA più rilevante al mondo, e il 2026 è l'anno in cui smette di essere teoria per la vostra organizzazione. Le pratiche vietate sono già sanzionabili. Gli obblighi per i modelli di IA per finalità generali si applicano da agosto 2025. L'Omnibus digitale — Regolamento (UE) 2026/1744, in vigore dal 27 luglio 2026 — ha rinviato gli obblighi per i sistemi ad alto rischio dell'allegato III al 2 dicembre 2027 (sistemi dell'allegato I: 2 agosto 2028). Sembra un orizzonte lungo, finché non ci si accorge che valutazioni della conformità, documentazione tecnica dell'allegato IV, valutazioni d'impatto sui diritti fondamentali e fascicoli delle evidenze tra fornitore e deployer vanno costruiti ben prima della scadenza.

Questo corso è la cassetta degli attrezzi di chi applica il regolamento. Non è un trattato giuridico né una preparazione a un esame: è il quaderno di lavoro che vi serve per mettere in pratica il regolamento già dal lunedì mattina. Percorriamo ogni capo del regolamento con la profondità che serve nella pratica, dalle definizioni dell'articolo 3 alle sanzioni dell'articolo 99, comprese le modifiche dell'Omnibus digitale. Imparerete a classificare qualsiasi sistema di IA alla luce dell'articolo 6 e dell'allegato III, a costruire la documentazione tecnica dell'allegato IV, a delimitare e svolgere una valutazione d'impatto sui diritti fondamentali e a pianificare una roadmap di 18 mesi che il vostro consiglio di amministrazione possa approvare.

Ancorato a un'azienda europea realistica. Ogni concetto, ogni esempio e ogni esercitazione si svolge in Lumora HR, un'azienda di tecnologie per la selezione del personale con sede a Berlino che è al tempo stesso fornitore di un sistema di preselezione ad alto rischio, deployer di strumenti di IA interni e fornitore a valle che lavora su un modello di IA per finalità generali. Alla fine della parte 7 avrete accompagnato Lumora da una crisi — la richiesta di evidenze di un cliente — fino a una roadmap di conformità pronta per il consiglio. È questo filo conduttore unico a far restare in mente i contenuti.

Che cosa saprete fare alla fine del corso:

  • Classificare qualsiasi sistema di IA alla luce dell'articolo 6, dell'allegato I e dell'allegato III, e applicare il test di deroga dell'art. 6(3)
  • Costruire la documentazione tecnica dell'allegato IV, le istruzioni per l'uso dell'articolo 13 e il fascicolo delle evidenze del deployer (articolo 26)
  • Delimitare e svolgere una valutazione d'impatto sui diritti fondamentali (FRIA) ai sensi dell'articolo 27 e coordinarla con la DPIA del GDPR
  • Impostare una roadmap di conformità di 18 mesi allineata al calendario dell'Omnibus digitale
  • Orientarsi nel codice di buone pratiche per l'IA per finalità generali e ottenere le evidenze giuste dai vendor dei modelli a monte
  • Presentare al consiglio di amministrazione l'esposizione alle sanzioni sui tre livelli dell'articolo 99

A chi si rivolge:

  • Responsabili della compliance e della governance dell'IA che impostano un programma di conformità al regolamento
  • Responsabili della protezione dei dati (DPO) che estendono il proprio ambito ai rischi dell'IA
  • Auditor interni che si occupano dei controlli sull'IA
  • Risk manager che costruiscono una tassonomia dei rischi dell'IA
  • Consulenti GRC che assistono clienti europei

Requisiti:

  • Una conoscenza pratica del GDPR, il regolamento generale sulla protezione dei dati (diamo per scontato che sappiate che cos'è una DPIA e che cosa fa l'articolo 6 del GDPR)
  • Nozioni di base sui sistemi di gestione (un'esperienza con la ISO 27001 o la ISO 9001 aiuta, ma non è necessaria)
  • Curiosità per l'IA, ma non serve alcuna formazione tecnica in machine learning

Che cosa include il corso:

  • 33 lezioni video in 7 parti: oltre quattro ore di video, con un taglio operativo
  • 7 quiz, per un totale di 50 domande, uno alla fine di ogni parte
  • 5 esercitazioni con soluzioni complete (memo di classificazione, indice della documentazione dell'allegato IV, perimetro di una FRIA, procedura per gli incidenti gravi, matrice delle evidenze dei vendor GPAI)
  • Un progetto finale: la roadmap di conformità di 18 mesi da presentare al consiglio di amministrazione
  • 23 template Word scaricabili, richiamati in tutto il corso, tra cui: inventario dei sistemi di IA, albero decisionale di classificazione, struttura dell'allegato IV, modulo FRIA, raccolta di informative di trasparenza (articolo 50), questionario per il vendor, dichiarazione di conformità UE, procedura per gli incidenti gravi e corrispondenza con la ISO 42001. Template, lezioni, quiz ed esercitazioni sono in italiano.

Quadro normativo aggiornato a ottobre 2026, compreso l'Omnibus digitale (Regolamento (UE) 2026/1744); il caso di studio Lumora è ambientato a maggio 2026. Il regolamento e gli orientamenti dell'ufficio per l'IA continuano a evolvere. In ogni lezione segnaliamo ciò che riflette la situazione a una data precisa, così sapete che cosa ricontrollare prima di consegnare i vostri documenti a un organismo notificato o a un auditor. Il corso non costituisce consulenza legale.

Alla fine di questo corso non sarete più la persona che in riunione dice «credo che dovremmo dare un'occhiata al regolamento sull'IA». Sarete quella che mette sul tavolo l'inventario, la classificazione, la documentazione tecnica, la FRIA e la roadmap.

Step into the future of technology with 100 Days of Quantum Computing Coding, a practical, project-based course designed to take you from complete beginner to confident quantum computing developer. Through 100 days of structured lessons, coding exercises, quantum circuits, algorithms, simulations, and real-world projects, you will develop the skills needed to understand and build quantum applications.

This course makes quantum computing for beginners approachable by combining essential theory with hands-on coding. You will begin by setting up your quantum development environment, refreshing the Python skills needed for quantum programming, and writing your first quantum program. You will then explore foundational concepts such as qubits, quantum states, vectors, basis states, superposition, measurement, probability amplitudes, and circuit visualization.

As you progress, you will learn how important quantum gates such as the X, Z, H, S, T, rotation, and controlled gates transform quantum states. You will build and analyze single-qubit and multi-qubit circuits while gaining practical experience with entanglement, Bell states, tensor products, CNOT gates, quantum correlations, and measurement outcomes.

The course also introduces the design and organization of complete quantum circuits. You will learn how to create reusable circuit blocks, parameterized circuits, modular workflows, and efficient quantum logic patterns. You will practice debugging circuits, comparing outputs, analyzing circuit depth, and improving the structure of your quantum programs.

A major part of the course focuses on quantum algorithms. You will implement and explore the Deutsch algorithm, Deutsch-Jozsa algorithm, Grover’s search algorithm, oracle design, quantum phase estimation, and other important computational techniques. You will compare quantum approaches with classical methods and build an intuitive understanding of when quantum algorithms may provide an advantage.

You will also explore advanced topics including quantum teleportation, superdense coding, variational quantum circuits, parameter optimization, quantum machine learning, circuit ansatz design, and hybrid quantum-classical workflows. These lessons will show you how quantum processors and classical computers can work together to solve complex problems.

Because real quantum computers are affected by noise, you will study quantum error handling, decoherence, relaxation, readout errors, noise models, error mitigation, and noise-aware circuit design. You will compare simulator results with real quantum hardware and learn how to evaluate circuit reliability using shot counts, histograms, and experimental data.

Later in the course, you will access real quantum hardware, select suitable backends, manage execution queues, understand hardware limitations, and run quantum circuits on real devices. You will also explore practical applications in quantum cryptography, optimization, quantum chemistry, random number generation, and emerging quantum technologies.

Every ten days, you will complete a practical mini project, including a quantum coin flip, gate playground, quantum random number generator, Bell state simulator, quantum logic lab, Grover search challenge, hybrid quantum model, noisy circuit study, and real-device experiment.

The final ten days guide you through building a complete quantum computing capstone project. You will choose a use case, design the circuit workflow, build and test the solution, create visualizations, document your findings, and package the project for your professional portfolio.

By the end of this course, you will have completed 100 days of quantum coding, built multiple hands-on projects, worked with simulators and real quantum devices, and created a portfolio demonstrating practical skills in Python quantum programming, quantum circuits, algorithms, hardware, and real-world quantum application development.

courseDetails.title: KI-nativer SDLC mit Claude Code: planen, bauen, prüfen
courseDetails.shortDescription: Bauen Sie Ihren Softwarelebenszyklus für agentische KI um – mit Gates, Evals und Audit-Nachweisen, die halten.
courseDetails.longDescription:
Dieser Kurs wurde unter Zuhilfenahme von künstlicher Intelligenz erstellt.

Etwa acht Wochen, nachdem eine Engineering-Organisation agentisches Programmieren für alle freigegeben hat, passiert etwas ganz Bestimmtes. Das Volumen gemergter Pull Requests verdoppelt sich ungefähr. Alle feiern. Und dann kommt die zweite Zahl: Die mediane Review-Zeit steigt, die Change-Failure-Rate klettert, und ein Quartal später fragt jemand in einem Audit, wer die Änderung freigegeben hat, die ein Agent um zwei Uhr nachts geschrieben hat — und niemand kann es beantworten.

Das ist kein KI-Problem. Es ist ein Prozessproblem. Wir sind sehr gut darin geworden, KI Code schreiben zu lassen, und haben jede Phase rund um den Code im menschlichen Tempo weiterlaufen lassen.

Dieser Kurs baut den Lebenszyklus selbst um. Er folgt dem AI-Native SDLC Playbook von Anthropic — sechs Phasen, angeordnet als Kreislauf statt als Linie: Jede Phase endet mit dem Commit eines Artefakts, und die nächste beginnt damit, es zu lesen. Sie bauen die ganze Kette: eine Absichtsdatei, eine Spezifikation, einen Plan, den Diff mit seinen Tests, den Pull Request mit seinen Review-Befunden und den Vorfallsbericht, der die nächste Absicht schreibt.

Jeder Mechanismus wird gebaut, nicht nur beschrieben. Sie schreiben einen PreToolUse-Hook, der eine Bearbeitung blockiert und den Freigabeweg nennt. Sie befragen Claude zu einem Plan, bevor eine Zeile Code existiert. Sie richten eine Eval-Suite ein, die die Konfiguration Ihres Agenten per Regressionstest prüft, wenn sich ein Skill ändert. Sie schreiben eine Review-Richtlinie mit Schweregrad-Schwelle und Nit-Obergrenze. Sie setzen ein Produktions-Gate, bis zu dem der Agent handeln darf und das er nicht passieren kann. Und Sie richten statistische Kontrollgrenzen ein, sodass eine Grenzverletzung bei drei Sigma sich selbst diagnostiziert und eine Absichtsdatei anlegt, bevor jemand alarmiert wird.

Governance ist ein vollwertiges Anliegen, kein Nachgedanke. Jedes Play in diesem Kurs benennt, was durchgesetzt wird, was der Nachweis ist, wo er protokolliert wird und wer freigibt. Sie lernen den teuersten Designfehler, den Teams machen — die falsche Stärke einer Kontrolle zu wählen — und den Unterschied zwischen einer Regel, die hält, und einem Satz in einer Datei, den niemand durchsetzt.

Wir arbeiten durchgehend mit einem Unternehmen. Meridian Pay ist eine B2B-Zahlungsplattform mit 640 Mitarbeitenden: von der britischen Finanzaufsicht FCA zugelassen, mit seiner EU-Gesellschaft im Anwendungsbereich von DORA, PCI DSS auf dem Karteninhaberpfad, SOC 2 und ISO 27001. Das Unternehmen hat Claude Code an 90 Engineers ausgerollt, sein PR-Volumen verdoppelt, die Change-Failure-Rate von 8 % auf 19 % steigen sehen und ein internes Audit nicht bestanden, weil es nicht nachweisen konnte, wer agentenerstellte Änderungen im PCI-Scope freigegeben hatte. Der CTO hat ein Quartal, um das zu beheben, ohne das Tempo wieder abzugeben. Jede Entscheidung in diesem Kurs wird unter dieser Vorgabe getroffen.

Sie gehen mit Artefakten nach Hause, nicht mit Notizen. Vorlagen für Absicht, Spezifikation, Plan und Review. Ein Hook für geschützte Pfade und ein Produktions-Gate-Hook. Ein Einstieg in eine Eval-Suite. Eine Konfiguration für Kontrollgrenzen. Ein Paket aus Früh- und Spätindikatoren mit einem Schritt zur Erfassung der Baseline. Ein Arbeitsblatt, das jedes Gate NIST SSDF, ISO/IEC 42001 und SOC 2 zuordnet. Und einen 90-Tage-Rollout-Plan, den Sie am Montag vor Ihrer Leitung vertreten können.

Fünfunddreißig Lektionen, acht Kapitel, fünf Aufgaben und eine abschließende Übungsprüfung. Für Engineering Leads, Plattform-Teams und alle, die für das Tempo und die Nachweise verantwortlich sind.

"Understanding Economic Sustainability: Balancing Growth and Responsibility" is a comprehensive course designed to provide students with a thorough understanding of the economic pillar of sustainability and its critical role in shaping a sustainable future.

Sustainability refers to the idea that humans must utilize Earth’s resources in ways that allow all life to co-exist and thrive, both now and in the future. The concept rests on three interdependent pillars: environmental, social, and economic. Each pillar is equally crucial, supporting and being supported by the others. This course focuses specifically on economic sustainability, examining its definition, significance, challenges, and strategies for implementation.

At the outset, you will learn about the current state of global economic health. Economic growth worldwide largely hinges on resource consumption. However, many resources, such as fossil fuels, are finite and are being used irresponsibly. Renewable resources, like trees, are consumed at rates faster than they can be replenished. This unsustainable consumption poses severe risks to both environmental and social stability. We need a balanced approach where economic prosperity, community well-being, and environmental resilience are achieved together.

Next, the course will delve into defining economic sustainability. Economic sustainability encompasses economic development, job creation, fair compensation, labor rights, and the circular economy, which promotes the reuse and regeneration of materials and products. This pillar enables society to innovate, solve problems, and improve living standards. However, it must be pursued in harmony with environmental and social goals, emphasizing responsible resource usage while minimizing negative impacts on the environment and society.

Understanding economic sustainability's importance is another key aspect covered in this course. A diverse, positive, and inclusive work culture enhances economic sustainability, leading to growth in jobs, green technology, and infrastructure. Equitable treatment of workers, ensuring their safety, fair treatment, and living wages, also play crucial roles.

You will explore how economic sustainability impacts the other pillars of sustainability. Economic changes such as eliminating poverty, encouraging responsible resource consumption, and meeting society’s needs can significantly improve social well-being. However, as people become wealthier, their resource consumption tends to increase, leading to negative environmental impacts. Ignoring environmental sustainability risks ecosystem collapse, highlighting the need for balance.

The course addresses the challenges of economic sustainability, including social inequity, the high costs of green technology and infrastructure, poverty, responsible resource management, political instability, and climate change. These challenges prompt crucial questions: How can we enhance living standards and create economic prosperity without compromising our environment? What will drive changes in our behaviors, culture, and policies toward sustainability?

Implementing change is a multi-level effort involving individuals, corporations, and institutions. Each must consider the environmental and social impacts when implementing policies, strategies, and behavioral changes. Corporate responsibility, in particular, plays a significant role. Businesses can promote an equitable workplace by integrating diversity and inclusion initiatives and providing living wages and benefits. Investing in green technology research and development, adopting manufacturing processes using renewable energy, conserving water, and reducing waste are practical corporate steps towards economic sustainability.

By the end of this course, you will possess a nuanced understanding of economic sustainability and its broader implications. You will be better equipped with knowledge and strategies to foster sustainable economic growth in ways that respect and protect our environment and society.

courseDetails.title: دليل المبتدئين في مجال إدارة سلاسل التوريدات
courseDetails.shortDescription: الدور والمنظور المستقبلي
courseDetails.longDescription:
دورة مدير سلسلة التوريد مصممة لتوفير رؤى شاملة حول مجال إدارة سلسلة التوريد الديناميكي. خلال البرنامج، سيقوم المشاركون باستكشاف مشاهد مختلفة تصوّر المسؤوليات والتحديات المتنوعة التي يواجهها مديرو سلسلة التوريد في عالمنا العالمي اليوم. وصف الدورة: انطلق في رحلة جذابة عبر عالم إدارة سلسلة التوريد مع دورتنا الشاملة.

انضم إلينا واستكشف دور متعدد الجوانب لمدير سلسلة التوريد، من حواضن المستودعات المزدحمة إلى قاعات الاجتماعات الاستراتيجية في مقرات الشركات. اختبر بيئة ديناميكية في المستودع، حيث ينسق مدير سلسلة التوريد حركة البضائع والمواد بدقة. شاهد رافعات الشوكية تمر بسرعة، وترصف المنصات بالمنتجات بارتفاع، بينما يقوم العمال بمسح وتسمية كل عنصر بدقة. اصعد إلى الميناء، حيث تنتظر السفن الضخمة شحناتها.

هنا، يشرف مدير سلسلة التوريد على تحميل وتفريغ الحاويات، مضمنًا توثيق كل شحنة بدقة وتخزينها بأمان. انتقل إلى المطار المزدحم، حيث يضمن مدير سلسلة التوريد تدفق البضائع بسلاسة من خلال الجمارك. يعمل عن كثب مع المسؤولين، لضمان أن جميع الأوراق اللازمة مرتبة بشكل صحيح، مسهلاً على تخليص الشحنات بكفاءة. ادخل إلى مرفق التصنيع، حيث يتعاون مدير سلسلة التوريد مع فرق الإنتاج لتحسين الجداول الزمنية وضمان توفير مستمر للمواد الخام. شاهد تحليل توقعات الطلب وضبط مستويات المخزون لتلبية متطلبات الإنتاج. استكشف غرفة التحكم عالية التقنية، حيث يراقب مدير سلسلة التوريد البيانات والتحليلات في الوقت الفعلي.

باستخدام أنظمة برامج متقدمة، يتتبع مستويات المخزون، ويحلل طرق النقل، ويحدد نقاط التوقف المحتملة أو التشوهات في سلسلة التوريد. في قاعة الاجتماعات، شاهد مدير سلسلة التوريد عرض خطط استراتيجية لأعلى المديرين التنفيذيين. يوضح المبادرات لتوفير التكاليف، ويقترح شراكات جديدة مع الموردين، ويلفت الانتباه إلى فرص التحسين في العملية، مُظهرًا خبرته في إدارة سلسلة توريد معقدة وديناميكية. اشترك في التنبؤ وإعادة التعبئة بالتعاون مع العملاء في غرفة الاجتماعات، حيث يضمن مدير سلسلة التوريد تلبية احتياجاتهم بفعالية.

أخيرًا، استكشف تطور دور مدير سلسلة التوريد، حيث يستخدم التكنولوجيا والذكاء الاصطناعي ليصبح محللاً مهارات سلسلة توريد بارعًا، دافعًا نحو الابتكار والكفاءة. انضم إلينا في هذه الرحلة المشوقة إلى عالم إدارة سلسلة التوريد واكتشف شغفًا وراء هذه المهنة الحيوية
targetAudiences: استشارين: استشاريو سلاسل الإمداد أو المحللون الذين يرغبون في توسيع قاعدة معارفهم وصقل خبرتهم لتقديم رؤى قيمة وحلول للعملاء.
المديرون والتنفيذيون: المسؤولون عن مراقبة عمليات سلسلة التوريد ضمن منظماتهم، الذين يسعون لتحسين الكفاءة وتقليل التكاليف وتعزيز الأداء العام.

courseDetails.title: Réponse aux incidents IA : incidents de LLM et d'agents
courseDetails.shortDescription: Détecter, contenir et corriger injections de prompt, abus d'outils, boucles d'agents et hallucinations en production
courseDetails.longDescription:
Ce cours utilise l'intelligence artificielle.

Il est quatre heures du matin. Votre agent autonome vient d'envoyer à mille quatre cents clients une lettre que personne n'a validée. La disponibilité est bonne. La latence est bonne. Le taux d'erreur est resté à zéro toute la nuit. Tous les tableaux de bord dont vous avez la charge sont au vert — et c'est précisément le problème.

C'est un cours d'exploitation. Pas de gouvernance, pas de red teaming, pas d'architecture. L'alerte s'est déjà déclenchée, et c'est vous qui tenez le pager. Vous apprendrez à détecter, trier, contenir, préserver les preuves, enquêter et rétablir le service face aux défaillances de systèmes LLM et d'agents en production — avec une organisation par mode de défaillance, jamais par référentiel.

Tout est enseigné sur l'exemple de Meridian Health, un assureur santé fictif qui exploite un assistant LLM pour les demandes de prise en charge et un agent d'exploitation autonome ayant accès, par ses outils, à une base de données des demandes, au courrier sortant et à un serveur MCP interne. Chaque incident que vous traitez frappe d'abord Meridian.

Ce qui distingue ce cours

  • Fondé sur l'AI Incident Response Framework V1.0 de la Coalition for Secure AI (CoSAI) — la première référence qui fasse véritablement autorité dans ce domaine — et rendu opérationnel plutôt que simplement résumé.
  • Onze playbooks nommés, tous construits sur la même colonne vertébrale en cinq parties : signaux, confinement, preuves, éradication, verrou de rétablissement.
  • Des cas réels, dont la décision du tribunal canadien qui a rejeté la défense « le chatbot est une entité juridique distincte », et les incidents documentés de coûts hors de contrôle de 2025–26.
  • Le coût traité comme un incident, et traité à fond — un sujet peu développé même dans les référentiels, et le mode de défaillance le mieux documenté de 2025–26.

Vous repartirez avec cinq livrables prêts pour la production : une matrice de gravité des incidents IA, des procédures de confinement pour votre propre pile, votre propre playbook d'incident, une liste de contrôle des preuves avec chaîne de conservation, et un modèle de revue post-incident attentif au modèle. Le projet final assemble les cinq, avec un état des lacunes et une feuille de route à 90 jours.

Neuf ateliers pratiques tournent entièrement sur votre propre machine, avec un modèle local — pas de clé d'API, pas de dépense cloud. Vous instrumenterez un agent, évaluerez des incidents en cours, mènerez un exercice de confinement chronométré, reconstituerez un incident à partir de preuves brutes et reconstruirez un verrou d'évals qui refuse de s'ouvrir tant que le correctif n'est pas prouvé.

Aucune expérience du développement d'attaques n'est nécessaire. Chaque incident des ateliers vous est confié alors qu'il est déjà en cours. Vous êtes l'intervenant, jamais l'attaquant.
targetAudiences: Analystes SOC et intervenants en réponse aux incidents dont l'organisation vient de mettre en production des systèmes LLM ou d'agents
Ingénieurs plateforme IA, MLOps et SRE qui possèdent la pile d'agents et sont de fait les intervenants
Responsables sécurité et ingénieurs AppSec qui répondent de systèmes d'IA qu'ils n'ont pas construits
Praticiens DFIR qui se tournent vers les incidents d'IA et veulent savoir ce qu'il faut réellement saisir
Professionnels GRC et risques qui doivent comprendre ce qu'implique une réponse opérationnelle aux incidents IA
